descriptions.preferred: This outstanding cultivar from Firma C. Esveld, Boskoop, Netherlands, has large, deeply cut, shiny, red leaves and, like the similar 'Trompenburg', is thought to be a cross between Acer palmatum and A. shirasawanum. It has very attractive deep red foliage and red fruits. The leaves are a darker color and have slightly flatter and wider lobes with larger teeth than those of

sources.title: 叶诗敏 Acer Shirasawawanum 'Yasemin'
sources.description: 由荷兰 Firma C. Esveld 苗圃的苗圃主 Cor Van Geldern 在 偶然的机会下发现的，以苗圃主女儿的字 Mirte Yasemin 命名 . 叶诗敏是血红鸡爪槭血红和 Acer Shirasawanum 白 泽槭的杂交，和 Acer Shirasawanum 'Gloria' - 歌莉娅非 常相似，叶诗敏有血红的叶色，龙爪的生长习性和白泽 槭的叶型。 叶诗敏春季新叶为樱桃红色，并有白色绒毛， 夏季变为棕绿色，秋天为紫红色，叶裂较深，生长快速， 并具有非常好的耐寒耐热性，成年树可达 4 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A vigorous, upright-growing tree, up to 10m high, with large, deeply divided, shiny, seven-lobed or nine-lobed leaves, coarsely toothed on the outer half, the young leaves emerging dark red in spring, slowly ageing to bronze-green above and grey-green by late summer, and turning orange-red in autumn, and tiny, purple-red flowers in small, pendent corymbs in spring followed by red-winged fruit in late summer

attributes.suggested_uses: Hedging/Screens, Low Maintenance, Banks and Slopes, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in full sun where its colours will develop best or in light dappled shade, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter, or by budding in summer; semi-ripe cuttings, hardwood cuttings, or layering may also be successful

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一出色的品种来自荷兰 Boskoop 的 Firma C. Esveld，具大型、深裂、富光泽的红叶，并与相似的 'Trompenburg' 一样，被认为是 Acer palmatum 与 A. shirasawanum 的杂交后代。 其深红色叶片和红色果实极具观赏性。 与 'Trompenburg' 相比，本品种叶色更深，裂片稍更平展且更宽，锯齿也更大。 叶色可较好保持至夏季，叶片上表面随后缓慢转为带古铜感的绿色；夏末叶背则转为灰绿色，并在叶尖附近带有浅紫古铜色晕染。 老枝树皮呈对比鲜明的绿色。 叶片具 7 或 9 裂，长 9 至 10 厘米，宽 8 至 9 厘米，裂片展开良好，使整叶近圆形。 裂片为长卵形，先端尖锐；裂片最宽处位于外侧三分之一处，其宽度约为裂片长度的三分之一。 裂片分裂深度至距叶基 5 至 10 毫米处，叶缘具大而粗的锯齿。 该品种生长势强，高大。 它起源于一批实生苗中的偶然变异，由 Cor van Gelderen 在 Firma C. Esveld 发现，并以其女儿 Mirte Yasemin 命名。 有趣的是，原株似乎同时表现出周围多株树木的影响: 具有

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合作绿篱/屏障、低维护种植、护坡与斜坡绿化、城市/庭院花园、乡村风/自然式花园，以及花境与花坛。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长旺盛、株形直立的乔木，高可达 10 米。 叶片较大、深裂，有光泽，具七裂或九裂，外半部具粗锯齿。 春季新叶萌发时为深红色，随后叶面逐渐老熟为古铜绿色，到夏末则呈灰绿色；秋季转为橙红色。 春季开细小的紫红色花，成下垂的小伞房花序，晚夏结红色翅果。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于可避开寒冷干风和晚霜的位置；全日照下叶色表现最佳，也可在疏荫环境中栽培。土壤应保持湿润但排水良好，宜中性至酸性，夏季不宜干透，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖疏松质地的有机覆盖物，如粗树皮，以利保湿护根。更多建议参见日本枫栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末进行嫁接繁殖，或于夏季芽接；半成熟枝扦插、硬枝扦插或压条繁殖有时也能成功。
